issue.title: just symvision red: 11 unused public helpers in ace/tui/modals/update_failure_geometry.py

task_type_fields.node_id: just symvision (lint (symvision) stage of just check)
task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
`just _lint-symvision` is deterministic static analysis (same tree, same result). At master 77ad508a6c it reports 11 unused public functions in `src/sase/ace/tui/modals/update_failure_geometry.py`: action_footer_lines, choose_outer_width, content_cell_width, footer_groups_for_width, hint_lines, is_cramped, logical_lines, max_cell_width, max_outer_size, pack_footer_lines, required_outer_width. All were added by 217a5439f5 ("feat(ace): adapt update failure dialog to content and terminal size", an ad-hoc apollo agent with no bead), so no epic owns them.

Usage outside the module (git grep): only `logical_lines` (8 src sites) and `hint_lines` (1 src site) are referenced from other src files; the rest are used only inside the module and by tests (choose_outer_width, is_cramped, max_outer_size, action_footer_lines, content_cell_width, pack_footer_lines) or not at all outside it (footer_groups_for_width, max_cell_width, required_outer_width). Fix per the symvision memory note: privatize module-internal helpers (adjusting tests to exercise the public entry points), keep genuinely shared ones public with a real cross-file caller, and delete any that are dead. Do not add blanket pragmas.

Proposed by sase-1jc.9 note #1, sase-1jc.11 note #3, and sase-1jc.12 note #4; reproduced by the sase-1jc land agent (ToolRun d149ccc8b78c563c53d20f299b833378, triaged KNOWN with witness 17dede15e22dfe4cc121a29f9489d6e8). Not caused by sase-1jc.
